correctness.rationale: The objective is a pointwise conditional least-squares projection with exact excess identity. Interior is O(epsilon^4). All relevant endpoint and no-overlap constraints are explicit. Finite midpoint experiments agree but are only supplementary.

value.rationale: The source's practically motivated mean-velocity approximation enjoys an interior variance-squared error bound; this exact smooth-data example shows its FULL observation cost instead has a sharp variance-to-3/2 order, driven by moving eligibility boundaries. The independently defined delay clipping recovers precisely half of the leading loss. These positive coefficients and degradation exponent clarify when an apparently excellent interior proxy cannot be extrapolated to a finite full horizon. This is not a mere normalization, tiny numerical adjustment or arbitrary invariant.
